title: Ethical Reasoning and Moral Value Alignment of LLMs Depend on the Language we Prompt them in
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on secular ethical reasoning based on normative ethics (deontology, virtue, consequentialism) in response to moral dilemmas.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on secular ethical reasoning across different languages and cultures.
